tasks.short: Oversee community or corporate recycling campaigns

steps.what: Review the recycling campaign plan and verify existing progress data
Compare campaign participation and recycling totals with programme targets
Assess campaign effectiveness and choose necessary changes
Coach campaign staff and coordinate agreed recycling-promotion changes

tasks.design: Configure an existing {SPREADSHEET} comparison view over campaign and recycling programme entries already used for oversight. The coordinator verifies the evidence, interprets progress and coaches campaign staff; this does not create or publish campaign messages.
tasks.previous_blocker: Campaign progress and targets are repeatedly totalled and compared.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables and formulas can repeat an explicit comparison without attributing causation.
tasks.still_hard: Campaign participation does not prove that the campaign caused waste reduction.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator understands local barriers and decides which interventions are credible.
tasks.altitude: Campaign decisions stay with the coordinator; repeated totals shrink.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed spreadsheet views can compare existing programme totals and targets; campaign effectiveness still requires interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary is campaign oversight already using participation entries and programme recycling totals. It does not assume new tracking, surveys or campaign-writing work. If these metrics are not kept today, do not invent their manual aggregation baseline.

Campaign staff already produce campaign identifier, reporting period and participation counts; programme operations supplies material category, period and collected quantities; the approved campaign plan supplies targets. s1 includes source retrieval, manual entry, unit/period checks and missing-data repair. No new capture is assigned free to staff.

Test native tables/formulas first. s2 removes explicit totals and target differences, not deciding what caused them. s1 and s3 retain full checking, incomparable-data repair and interpretation. Extra repair lowers the estimate; system runtime earns no labour saving.

s4 is live internal coordination. No mandatory minutes, progress log or separate dispatch is established here; add actual document changes or sends if present rather than inventing a trailing record. Shares are model estimates.
unknowns: Existing oversight metrics and their comparability
Whether campaign changes require a separate written approval
research_questions: Are periods and material categories comparable enough for a fixed view?
Observe arithmetic separately from assessing campaign effects

already_counted.description: Verify and capture evidence, repair incomparable periods and interpret comparisons.

incremental.description: Maintain campaign-period/category mappings and target references.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 20 calculation points less 1.5 upkeep. Conservative new campaign has changed collection categories and no comparable participation history; only three points of same-period arithmetic are reusable, leaving 1.5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify recycling stops, collection needs and operating constraints
Calculate feasible recycling collection routes and time sequences
Assess collection service trade-offs and resolve exceptional stops
Coordinate the proposed collection schedule with operations staff
Complete and check the final collection schedule and dispatch destination
Dispatch the approved collection schedule to operations

tasks.design: Configure native route and time-window constraints in the collection planning module of {OPS_SYSTEM}. The coordinator verifies candidate schedules, resolves exceptional service needs with operations, completes the final version and retains its separately gated dispatch through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stop sequences and collection windows are repeatedly recalculated.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing collection route software can calculate candidate schedules from explicit constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Unmapped access limits, unusual material loads and service commitments require operational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator negotiates a workable service compromise rather than accepting the shortest route blindly.
tasks.altitude: The coordinator retains service decisions while native calculations produce options.

evidence.claim: AMCS supports recycling collection route optimisation and documents its use at RenoNorden. Vendor mileage claims are not labour savings for this task.

assumptions: Boundary is an existing collection scheduling cycle through internal operations dispatch. It excludes staff assignment based on individual behaviour and introduces no driver GPS or new monitoring.

Existing service records supply stop identifier, location, material class, frequency, estimated load and access window; operations supplies vehicle capacity and availability. s1 verifies and manually captures missing restrictions. s3-s5 retain manual route repair and all final schedule revisions. No new input maintenance is free or transferred.

Try the native route module first. s2 removes explicit sequence/time/capacity calculations, not service priorities or coordination. Existing system computation is not labour. If route calculation is already automatic, its current manual share must be replaced before claiming a gain.

s5 includes full route, service coverage and recipient checks and ordinary saving. s6 is an actual internal dispatch, kept at one fully retained point; it is gated only after final schedule completion. Any change voids approval. No automatic public service notice is hidden here.
Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Mapped access restrictions and exceptional stop rates
research_questions: Can the native planner expose all unserved constraints?
How much manual route repair remains for rural or restricted-access stops?

already_counted.description: Input verification and capture, exceptional route repair, coordination and final schedule checking.

incremental.description: Maintain collection constraint mappings and test planning settings after service changes.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final collection schedule and operations recipients; any revision voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 30 calculation points less two upkeep. Conservative newly added collection area has unmapped access limits and uncertain travel times; only five points of known-stop capacity/time calculations disappear, leaving three net. Coordination and dispatch remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop realistic recycling plans and waste-minimisation goals

steps.what: Verify waste streams, resource constraints and community needs
Calculate the resource and waste effects of specified recycling scenarios
Develop recycling priorities, goals and practical measures
Write the recycling plan from decided goals and measures

loop.purpose: Phrase the coordinator's selected measures in the existing plan structure
loop.input: Decided goals, measures, resource limits and referenced calculations
loop.output: Draft plan retaining constraints and uncertainty
loop.check: Coordinator checks each target, measure, cost and causal claim against decisions and sources and checks omitted constraints
loop.stop: Missing decisions or two failed revisions returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables populate figures first; variable explanatory prose remains

steps.what: Check and revise the complete recycling plan

tasks.design: Use native {SPREADSHEET} scenario calculations for explicitly selected assumptions and {DOCS} for the plan. The coordinator chooses goals and measures, while a bounded loop assists only the residual explanatory prose; complete plan checking and ordinary saving remain with the author.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated resource calculations and explanatory drafting compete with planning judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and source-bound drafting can reuse selected assumptions without deciding goals.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain participation, resource trade-offs and acceptable goals need community and operational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator chooses feasible and fair measures under actual resource limits.
tasks.altitude: Planning decisions remain unchanged; explicit scenario calculations become easier to inspect.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit recycling resource scenarios can use fixed calculations, while source-bound drafting can phrase already-decided goals.

assumptions: Boundary is developing and checking a recycling plan, before formal adoption, budget commitment or publication. Those actions need actual approval and dispatch steps if included. Ordinary author saves are fully retained and ungated.

s1 captures waste category, quantity, period, existing capacity, cost, staff availability and community constraints from existing operations and budget records and coordinator consultation. s1 also specifies scenario quantities, assumed participation and resource changes; no model invents these assumptions and no new input producer is free.

Native formulas and fixed plan fields first. s2 removes repeated arithmetic only. s3 retains scenario interpretation and decisions. s4 retains 16 points for source checking and drafting repairs, s5 retains ten for full numerical/meaning/constraint review and manual calculation fallback. More repair lowers the estimate.
The plan is an actual task output, not a newly created oversight record. Shares are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Quality and compatibility of waste and resource records
Amount of repeated calculation versus original assumption setting
research_questions: Can each plan target be traced to an explicit coordinator decision?
Test scenarios with changed material categories and uncertain participation

already_counted.description: Capture and validate planning inputs, review and repair prose, check the complete plan and repair calculations.

incremental.description: Maintain scenario formulas and plan drafting instructions as programme assumptions change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 20 arithmetic and four wording points less 1.5 upkeep. Conservative new treatment technology has incomparable costs and new explanatory requirements: only three standard capacity calculations and 0.8 point of decided-goal wording are reusable, giving 2.3 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and submit a recycling programme grant application

steps.what: Read the grant's eligibility criteria and application requirements
Verify recycling project facts, eligible costs and funding commitments
Calculate eligible grant budget totals and funding shares
Populate fixed grant application fields and attachment lists
Write the recycling project's grant narrative

loop.purpose: Phrase evidenced project goals and delivery plans for the grant questions
loop.input: Verified project facts, decided commitments and exact funder questions
loop.output: Narrative with evidence references and no new commitments
loop.check: Coordinator checks factual support, eligibility claims, omissions, budgets and whether wording creates unsupported promises
loop.stop: Missing evidence or two failed revisions returns to manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed fields and budget tables are native templates; distinct funder questions need variable prose

steps.what: Check the entire application and repair form or budget errors
Approve the final grant application and submission destination
Submit the approved grant package to the public funder

tasks.design: Use native {SPREADSHEET} budget tables and {DOCS} application fields before a bounded loop phrases the evidenced project narrative. The coordinator checks the whole package and an authorised sponsor approves its exact final version; a native {GOV_PORTAL} submission action operates only if supported and permitted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each application repeats budget arithmetic, fixed-field entry and evidenced narrative drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured tables, forms and a bounded drafting loop can reuse verified project inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Eligibility, credible benefits and binding funding promises require accountable decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator knows which project outcomes and resource commitments are defensible.
tasks.altitude: The coordinator remains application author, with organisational commitments approved by the sponsor.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed grant budget/form fields and evidenced narrative drafting can be assisted; native submission support is an unverified local requirement.

assumptions: Boundary is an existing public grant application cycle through actual submission, for a funder permitting a native submission action. If the portal requires personal interaction, keep s8 fully retained; a private funder's destination requires a different slot and access check.

s1-s2 produce application identifier, applicant details, question text, project dates, decided goals, cost lines, eligibility categories, funding rate, co-funding evidence, attachment references and exact funder destination. The coordinator verifies and manually captures these from existing plans, finance evidence and guidance. No new finance preparation or sponsor labour is transferred free.

Test native tables, form mappings and portal actions before code. s3 removes arithmetic only, s4 fixed-field entry only, and s5 retains 12 points for wording checks and repair. s2/s6 retain missing-field capture, manual budget/form fallback and full meaning/attachment checks; extra repair reduces the estimate.

Sponsor review occurs after the complete final package and destination exist. Any content, budget, commitment, attachment or destination change voids approval. s8 is an actual public submission, not an ordinary author save; ordinary draft saves are fully retained and ungated. Receipt/failure inspection is retained in s6's allowance, with extra failures reducing gains.
Focal baseline is 96 points; sponsor review is excluded rather than credited. Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Portal automation permission and native support
Funder form stability and manual repair burden
Actual sponsor review and application drafting shares
research_questions: Can the final approved package be bound exactly to the portal payload?
Does narrative assistance preserve all eligibility qualifications and avoid new promises?

already_counted.description: Criteria reading, evidence capture, narrative checking, full application review and manual repair/receipt checks.

incremental.description: Maintain funder field mappings, budget formulas and approval-to-submission binding.

approvals.approved_version: s7 exact final application, budget, attachments and public funder destination; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 15 arithmetic, 15 fixed-entry, three narrative and one real-submission points: 34/96*100 minus two = 33.42. Conservative unfamiliar grant has new eligibility categories and little reusable form content: only three arithmetic, three fixed-entry, 0.5 wording and 0.2 submission points disappear; 6.7/96*100 minus two = 4.98.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A recycling coordinator who retains service choices, goals and evidence judgements while native calculations and source-bound drafting reduce specific repeated operations.
skills_to_grow: Validate collection constraints and comparable waste categories
Test resource scenarios without inventing assumptions
Check application commitments and final-version submission gates
role.ambitious_version: Build dependable recycling plans and applications from existing operational evidence without creating unpriced tracking or capture duties.
